text: dsh-all-in-one 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件聚合 bundle，把 12 个独立插件作为一组安装并挂载到同一 bundle 层。它依据 aggregate.yml 生成依赖清单和 Cordis patch 行，包含编码工具、插件管理、侧栏、用量界面、更新器、图片预览等插件，并保留各插件的规范行 ID，支持在 profile patch 中单独禁用插件。适合希望一次装入这组 DSH 扩展的用户；安装需要 Node.js 22 或更高版本环境来生成或校验发布文件，日常使用按 DSH 插件命令添加。

dsh-all-in-one bundles 12 DSH plugins in one install, including coding tools, plugin management, a sidebar, usage views, updaters, and image previews. It keeps each plugin’s canonical Cordis ID, allowing selected plugins to be disabled in a profile patch. Install with the DSH plugin command.
想一次把一组常用 DSH 插件装好。
有没有能把多个 DSH 扩展合并安装的 bundle？
I want to install a collection of DSH plugins in one step.
dsh-all-in-one 的功能「聚合插件安装」：通过一个 DSH 插件 bundle 同时安装并挂载清单中的 12 个独立插件，覆盖编码工具、侧栏、插件管理及其他扩展。用户使用 DSH 插件添加命令安装。
dsh-all-in-one 的功能「保留独立插件配置」：聚合行沿用各插件的规范 ID，用户可以在 DSH profile patch 中按行禁用不需要的插件。

dsh-all-in-one README · Repository model：- This repository coordinates the plugin collection; it does not merge their histories.
- Plugin directories are independent Git repositories. Use `git -C <plugin> ...` for plugin work.
- Update the pinned plugin revision in the master repo with `git -C <plugin> pull` followed by `git add <plugin>`.
- Do not commit DSH source changes here or inside a plugin. Plugins must be mounted through the DSH profile and `cordis.patch.yml` mechanism.
- Code changes follow each plugin’s contribution rules; documentation-only collection changes may be made here.

dsh-all-in-one README · DSH plugin behavior：Plugins are Cordis modules with optional host and client halves. The package manifest declares the DSH bundle patch and client injection metadata. Host code must use public DSH services/routes; client code must use injected services and must unload cleanly.

dsh-all-in-one README · DSH plugin behavior：For better-sidebar integrations, see [`dsh-better-sidebar/AGENTS.md`](./dsh-better-sidebar/AGENTS.md). Key rules: use `inject = ['betterSidebar']`, register tabs/viewers through `ctx.betterSidebar`, wrap registration in `ctx.effect()` so the disposer is HMR-safe, use package-prefixed IDs, and keep `dsh-better-sidebar` as an optional peer dependency. The service exists only on the client side.
